context: Two cafe friends compare weekend dining picks
purpose: Teach: オリーブ/カギ/多摩/キムチ/マクドナルド/フレンチ/ティッシュ/ダイナミック

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 週末さ、多摩のほうに新しくできたフレンチのお店行ってきたんだよね。
lines.en: This weekend, I went to a new French restaurant that opened over in Tama.
lines.style: Warm and chatty barista sharing weekend news

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: えー素敵!フレンチって響きだけでもう胸がときめいちゃう。どんなお料理だったの?
lines.en: Oh how lovely! Just hearing 'French' makes my heart flutter. What kind of dishes were there?
lines.style: Dreamy romantic voice full of swooning excitement

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 前菜のサラダにオリーブがごろっと乗ってて、オリーブオイルの香りがすごく良かったの。
lines.en: The appetizer salad had whole olives on it, and the olive oil aroma was amazing.
lines.style: Soft enthusiastic tone describing flavors gently

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うっとりしちゃう…私はね、彼と二人でこぢんまりした韓国料理屋でキムチ鍋つついてたの。
lines.en: How dreamy... Me, I was sharing a kimchi hotpot at a cozy little Korean place with my boyfriend.
lines.style: Soft swooning voice reminiscing about a date

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あー寒い夜にキムチ鍋は最高だよね。私たちなんて帰り道マクドナルドにも寄っちゃってさ。
lines.en: Ah, kimchi hotpot on a cold night is the best. We even stopped by McDonald's on the way home.
lines.style: Laughing barista voice confessing a guilty pleasure

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: フレンチのあとにマクドナルド!?そのギャップ、なんかダイナミックな展開で素敵すぎる。
lines.en: McDonald's after French cuisine?! That gap is such a dynamic twist, it's wonderfully charming.
lines.style: Giggling teasing romantic voice playful and dramatic

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 笑わないでよー。ポテト食べすぎて指がベタベタで、ティッシュ箱まるごと使った気がする。
lines.en: Don't laugh! I ate so many fries my fingers were sticky and I think I used a whole tissue box.
lines.style: Embarrassed laughing barista voice playfully whining

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 可愛い〜。あ、そういえば帰りに家のカギを車に置き忘れて、開けるのに一苦労だったの。
lines.en: How cute~. Oh, by the way, I left my house keys in the car and had a real struggle getting in.
lines.style: Affectionate giggle pivoting into a sheepish anecdote

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あるある!カギ忘れって本当に焦るよね。来週は私の番、お店紹介させて?
lines.en: Classic! Forgetting your keys is genuinely panic-inducing. Next week's my turn, can I pick the place?
lines.style: Cheerful barista wrapping up with a friendly invitation
